principals.name: U
principals.description: EDHOC initiator in the pre-shared-key mode. Holds the PSK shared with V, sends message_1 with its ephemeral DH share and the PSK identifier, and derives the OSCORE master secret.

principals.name: V
principals.description: EDHOC responder in the pre-shared-key mode. Holds the same PSK, answers with its own ephemeral share in message_2, and derives the same OSCORE master secret. No signature key is used in this mode.

values.name: PSK
values.description: The uniformly random pre-shared key U and V are assumed to share before the run.

values.name: KID
values.description: The identifier of the pre-shared key, sent in message_1; V must be able to identify the PSK from it, so it is provisioned together with the PSK.
